title: REPORT on European Central Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: 9. Regrets that core inflation still remains high in the euro area (2.7 % in December 2024), with only three euro area Member States reporting core inflation rates below 2 % in December 2024; recalls that this situation generates economic uncertainty, discourages savings and increases citizens’ living costs, particularly affecting those on fixed and limited incomes;
